Arafta (Bound by Fate) is a gripping Turkish revenge drama that explores the thin line between hatred and love. The story follows Ateş Karahan (Emin Günenç), a man consumed by the scars of his childhood, who returns to his hometown to dismantle the family he believes destroyed his past. His weapon of choice is a 187-day contract marriage with Mercan Yıldırım (İlsu Demirci), the innocent daughter of his enemy.
While Ateş views Mercan as a mere pawn in his quest for justice, their forced proximity ignites an undeniable passion that neither anticipated. Caught in a "purgatory" (the literal meaning of Arafta) between family loyalty and a forbidden attraction, the two must navigate a web of deep-seated secrets, jealous rivals like Aslı, and the haunting truth about their shared history.
